component.name: Ask the Model
component.summary: Chat with local AI and scientific model repositories

description.p: Ask the Model is a local-first desktop chat interface for locally managed language models through an Ollama-compatible provider. It discovers completion-capable provider-managed models and keeps conversation state in memory for the current application session.

The current release can also query the fixed Empirical World3 Dynamics, Cognitive Belief Dynamics and Romanian Monetary Dynamics repository suite. It manages validated immutable local snapshots, uses deterministic repository retrieval, freezes repository/model identity per conversation, and exposes exact source provenance through on-demand citations. The source repositories remain authoritative for their own scientific content.
Repository-grounded multi-chat with validated EWD/CBD/RMD snapshot lifecycle, deterministic retrieval, frozen per-conversation scope and exact on-demand citation provenance.
Documentation and public-metadata consistency update with expanded first-time setup guidance, model-management documentation and corrected application metadata.
Installation and release-distribution correction with a directly downloadable Flatpak release asset and clarified dependency guidance.
Local Chat Baseline with local Ollama discovery, completion-capable AI-model selection, refresh progress, streamed chat and in-session history.
